contracts: SecureStateDriver native state-visibility owns actual fixed-token member/pet/target visibility, including combat existence changes.
RestrictedFrames.GetAttribute rejects private underscore attributes; public roster-layout-ready is readable.
RestrictedFrames.SetPoint rejects inherited-only relative handles; $parent resolves the actual parent without that invalid handle.
Native UnitFramePortrait_Update delegates portrait caching/unavailability to SetPortraitTexture. Flux falls back to this engine sink; async model completion restores 3D.
Native UnitFrame_UpdateThreatIndicator uses threat-warning enable/dead/status and GetThreatStatusColor. Flux guards opaque results and applies only an owned transparent border overlay.

pairedContracts.interpretation: Functional regression only. Baseline fails the actual secret-alpha branch; candidate additionally checks inherited-handle rejection and $parent success on five upstream sources. No native CPU/FPS comparison.

resources.range: Existing native range events with existing shared fallback ticker; no party-only ticker.
resources.threat: Four noninteractive owned transparent border overlays in alternate mode; native threat events, no flash animation.
